description: Inventory of logs for the DupliMend experiment runner. Each entry fully specifies how one log is loaded and evaluated, so a run is reproducible from this file plus duplimend_global.json plus seeds.json.

paper_inventory.note: 1,304 logs x 10 seeds = 13,040 runs per method, which matches the row count of the per-run result files.
paper_inventory.availability: The bundled manifest below covers only the two logs generated for this study (I-PALIA and the document-review process), which are the ones this repository redistributes. Every other log in the 1,304 is a publicly available third-party dataset and is not vendored here; obtain it from its original source and add a manifest entry. The synthetic duplicated-task logs come from the BPM2016 duplicated-tasks collection (a partial copy of four generator folders -- feb16-1625, feb17-0936, mrt02-1452, mrt03-1655 -- is included under python-label-refinement-baselines/data/noImprInLoop_default_OD/ for the baseline code); the real-life logs (BPIC 2012/2013/2017, Environmental Permits, Road Traffic Fines) are published on 4TU.ResearchData.

entry_schema.id: Stable identifier used in the results file and the resume ledger.
entry_schema.dataset_type: Synthetic | Real-life | Synthetic-named. Free text; carried into the results file.
entry_schema.input: Path to the input CSV, relative to the repository root.
entry_schema.ground_truth: Path to the ground-truth CSV, relative to the repository root.
entry_schema.activity: The imprecise activity label to be refined (DEFAULT_ACTIVITY).
entry_schema.control_flow_column: CONTROL_FLOW_COLUMN, the activity column in the input log.
entry_schema.ground_truth_activity_column: GROUND_TRUTH_ACTIVITY_COLUMN, the true-label column in the ground-truth file.
entry_schema.timestamp_column: TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, the event timestamp column. Required: main.py reads it while consuming the stream, and a wrong name fails on every event.
entry_schema.resource_column: RESOURCE_COLUMN, optional resource attribute. Omit or null when the log has none.
entry_schema.config_overrides: Per-log environment overrides applied AFTER the global paper config. These settings are dataset-specific: clustering_threshold in particular differs per log because the feature paths differ (I-PALIA has no data columns and uses control-flow features only, DocReview adds four data attributes), so the useful DBSTREAM radius is not shared between them.

per_log_configuration_note: IMPORTANT: several DupliMend settings are per-log, not global. clustering_threshold and warmup_global_events in particular must be set per dataset -- a value that works on one log produces a single micro-cluster (no refinement) on another. The correct values are recorded in each entry's config_overrides below and are applied by scripts/run_paper_experiments.py after the global configuration in duplimend_global.json. Values used for these logs: I-PALIA uses clustering_threshold 0.01 with warmup 4000; DocReview uses clustering_threshold 0.95 with warmup 100000. The logs do not share a feature path -- every column of I-PALIA is excluded as an id/timestamp/activity column, so it is embedded from control-flow features alone, whereas DocReview contributes four data attributes (PriorityLevel, FileSize, ProcessingTime, Resource) -- which is why the useful DBSTREAM radius differs by two orders of magnitude between them.
